findings.message: the pinned Triton backend cannot warp-specialize a loop containing the value-and-index argmin reduction
declared logical register storage has an optimistic lower bound of 81 registers per thread across 256 threads; this bounds maximum possible residency but is not ptxas-measured allocation

logical_register_storage bounds maximum possible residency to 3 CTA per multiprocessor (20544 of 65536 registers); the next bounds are threads 8; this Schedule declares no shared_memory or tensor_memory, so nothing here bounds it and a backend may still allocate some
